<abbr title="Koh-Lanta: The Relics of Destiny">'''''Koh-Lanta: Les Reliques du Destin'''''</abbr> is the thirty-third season of {{version2|fr}}.

After 39 days, [[Cynthia Combes]] defeated [[Clarisse Cresseveur]] in a 10-3 jury vote to become the [[Sole Survivor]].
==Production==
{{Empty section}}
==Twists/Changes==
* '''[[One World (twist)|One World]] Format:''' Before the two tribes were made, all 20 castaways were marooned on the same island and spent the first night together there. As the winner of the first Immunity Challenge on Day 2, the [[Kalao]] tribe earned the right to go back to the marooning beach.
* '''[[Schoolyard Pick]]:''' As the winner of the first Reward Challenge, [[Clarisse Cresseveur|Clarisse]] became the first tribe captain. She then chose [[Paul Estival|Paul]] as the opposite tribe captain and both drew their tribe via a schoolyard pick.
* '''The Relics of Destinies:''' Each time a castaway is voted out, they enter the Lair of Destinies. There they will have to choose one of eight potteries and hope for a chance to go back into the game:
** '''Three potteries are empty:''' the voted out castaway is immediately eliminated from the game.
** '''Two potteries contain an [[Immunity Idol|Immunity Necklace]]:''' the voted out castaway must choose one of their former tribemate to be granted the necklace and then exit the game. This necklace can be given to anyone, but must be played at their next Tribal Council.
** '''One pottery contains a second chance:''' the voted out castaway stays in the game and joins the opposite tribe, alongside an Immunity Necklace, with the same rules than the ones aforementioned.
** '''Two potteries contain an opportunity to fight in a [[Duel]]:''' the voted out castaway chooses one of their tribemate to challenge in a duel. The loser of the duel is immediately eliminated from the game, whereas the winner is granted an Immunity Necklace, with the same rules than the ones aforementioned.
* '''The Relics of Destinies:''' Following the first Tribal Council of the merged tribe, seven new potteries have been introduced:
** '''Three potteries are empty:''' the voted out castaway is immediately eliminated from the game.
** '''Two potteries contain a [[Vote Blocker|Vote Removal]]:''' the voted out castaway must prevent one of their former tribemate to vote at the next Tribal Council.
** '''One pottery contains an opportunity to fight in a [[Duel]]:''' the voted out castaway chooses one of their tribemate to challenge in a duel. The loser of the duel is immediately eliminated from the game, whereas the winner is granted an Immunity Necklace, with the same rules than the ones aforementioned.
** '''One pottery contains an opportunity to fight in a three-way [[Duel]]:''' the voted out castaway chooses one of their tribemate to challenge in a duel. They are joined by the castaway voted out at the previous Tribal Council. The loser of the duel is immediately eliminated from the game, whereas the winner is granted an Immunity Necklace, with the same rules than the ones aforementioned.
* '''Secret Pottery:''' In the Lair of Destinies, a ninth secret pottery has been hidden under a rock. It contains an opportunity to fight in a [[Duel]], with the same rules than the ones aforementioned.
* '''[[Ambassadors]]:''' At the merge, both tribes must send two of their members to the ambassadors meeting, where they must directly eliminate a castaway from the game. If the four ambassadors do not agree on a name, a rock draw is held between the two pairs representing each tribe, and the pair that loses the draw competes in a [[duel]] where the loser is eliminated from the game.
